title: ULTABEAUTY_2023Q4_EARNINGS.pdf
summary: The section provides a comprehensive overview of Ulta Beauty's financial performance for the fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2022, reporting net sales of $3.2 billion and a 15.6% increase in comparable sales. It highlights record annual revenue exceeding $10 billion and net income surpassing $1 billion for the first time, with key metrics including a gross profit margin of 37.6% and diluted earnings per share of $6.68. Additionally, it outlines plans for fiscal 2023, including projected net sales, store openings, and insights into operational strategies and market outlook.
